blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI for Capital Markets & Wealth Management: what the sector's controls demand, what we build on the platform rails, and the outcomes written into the engagement.

Wealth and capital-markets clients buy judgment and pay for experience: advisors need research and portfolio context in minutes, operations need settlement and reconciliation without firefights, and compliance needs evidence without expeditions.

items: Advisors assemble portfolio context from terminals, PDFs and CRM; response quality depends on prep time.
Suitability checks and disclosure packs assembled manually per trade; audit trails thin.

blocks.x: The pattern composes AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation, Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems, Conversational AI & Digital Humans from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Advisor research and prep, Reconciliation and breaks, Client reporting) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — MiFID II / fiduciary regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Models that read scans, scenes and schematics: multimodal intelligence wired into operations.
Voice and avatar interfaces that resolve, not deflect — with emotion-aware escalation and full auditability.
Replace hype with evidence: feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks.
Portfolio context, research and market moves summarized with citations pre-meeting (prep time down 40-60%)

blocks.caption: Regimes shaping this capability
rows: ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Banking & Financial Services level this capability reads as: analysts draft credit memos with retrieval over mandates, financials and policy, every paragraph citing its source (memo preparation time down 50-60%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The rhythm is fixed on purpose: progress becomes visible from week one, not after the first steering meeting. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
